notes: Dual-register: FLORES+ (formal) + MASSIVE (assistant utterances); premium reported per corpus. Anthropic counters run when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is present (aggregate + per-sentence subsample per corpus); Gemini via offline google-genai LocalTokenizer (no key); Llama 4 via HF AutoTokenizer (gated repo, needs HF_TOKEN). `corpora_carried_forward` / `counters_carried_forward` list slices preserved verbatim from the prior dataset (not re-measured this pass); the measured set is their complement. `envelope_tokens_by_counter` is the per-message chat frame (measured, 0 for bare-text counters) subtracted from raw_counts.n_tokens_content so the per-sentence premium distribution compares Claude's wrapped counts like-for-like with the offline counters; the aggregate is left envelope-inclusive. API per-sentence rows are a DETERMINISTIC head-slice (sentences[:subsample]), not a random sample.
